problem:
Find the fifth term of the sequence given by the recurrence relation

$$
{a}_{n}=2{a}_{n-1}-3,\,{a}_{1}=5,\,n\ge 2.
$$
worked_solution:
Starting with the first term ${a}_{1}=5,$ we compute the next terms using the recursive formula until we reach the fifth term.

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =5 \\ {a}_{2} & =2{a}_{1}-3=2\cdot 5-3=7 \\ {a}_{3} & =2{a}_{2}-3=2\cdot 7-3=11 \\ {a}_{4} & =2{a}_{3}-3=2\cdot 11-3=19 \\ {a}_{5} & =2{a}_{4}-3=2\cdot 19-3=35\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the fifth term is ${a}_{5}=35.$
